Profile Metampicillin has actions and uses similar to those of ampicillin (p.204). After oral doses it is almost completely hydrolysed to ampicillin. When given parenterally, however, a proportion of the dose ex- ists in the circulation as unchanged metampicillin which has some antibacterial activity of its own.
